pages.text: At the foot of the Realm, some 650 blocks below the Number Line, a broad plain of $(item)Postulate Slate$(): what every proof stands on.

$(thing)Liar's Vaults$() are sealed halls floored in light and dark, true and false, with two doors: one of them is only glass. $(thing)Proof Stairs$() wind up thirty to fifty steps round a pillar, each step standing on the one before it (induction). Both hold caches.

$(item)Paradox Shades$() are true, then false, then true again every few seconds. True, they are solid and hunt you; false, they are dark outlines that nothing can touch. Strike them while they are true.
$(thing)Contradiction$(): every half minute or so, two opposite effects at once (fast and slow, strong and weak). A $(item)Proof Certificate$() carried keeps you consistent.

$(item)Tautology Ore$() gives $(item)Tautology Shards$(). On the Formal Proof Assistant: two Proof Certificates from two shards and two paper; two Axiom Schemas from two shards, two lattices and a book; two Proof Fragments from 32 Postulate Slate and two shards; and eight Postulate Slate from eight cobblestone and a shard.
